Description: Allows a guest to create a buyer account with name, email and password. Validates input, hashes the password and prevents duplicate emails.
Authenticates a buyer with email and password and issues an access token to start a session.
Ends the buyer session, clears the stored token and returns the user to the public homepage.
Lets a buyer request a password reset link sent to their registered email address.
Validates the reset token from the email link and lets the buyer set a new password.
Creates a seller account with owner details and store contact information, flagged as pending admin approval.
Authenticates a seller and grants access to the seller dashboard scoped to their own store.
Ends the seller session and clears dashboard access.
Lets a seller request a password reset link for their seller account.
Validates the seller reset token and stores the new password securely.
Authenticates an administrator through a separate admin entry point with stricter session rules.
Sends a verification link after registration and marks the account as verified once confirmed.
Issues, refreshes and revokes JWT access tokens, including expiry handling and token storage rules.
Central permission layer that restricts every endpoint and page to the correct role: guest, buyer, seller or admin.
Landing page showing featured products, promoted categories and highlighted stores to start the shopping journey.
Paginated grid of all published products with image, title, price and store name.
Keyword search across product titles, descriptions and categories with an empty state for no results.
Narrows product results by category, price range, store and availability.
Orders product results by newest, price ascending, price descending or popularity.
Lets buyers explore products grouped by craft category such as textiles, ceramics or woodwork.
Browsable list of all approved seller stores with logo, name and short description.
Public store page showing the store profile, banner and all products sold by that seller.
Full product view with image gallery, price, description, stock status, seller info and reviews.
Lets a buyer save products for later and add or remove items from a personal wishlist.
Adds a product with a chosen quantity to the buyer cart and validates it against available stock.
Lets a buyer view cart items, change quantities and remove products, grouped by seller store.
Calculates subtotal, delivery fee and order total, and keeps the values in sync when the cart changes.
Collects and validates the delivery address and contact number before the order is placed.
Lets the buyer choose a payment method and confirms the charge through the payment gateway.
Converts the cart into a persisted order, reduces product stock and clears the cart.
Success screen showing the order number, purchased items and expected delivery information.
Order history list showing every past order with date, total and current status.
Detailed view of one order with line items, delivery address, payment method and status timeline.
Lets a buyer cancel an order while it is still pending and restores the reserved stock.
Lets a buyer rate and review a product they have purchased, limited to one review per order item.
Lets a buyer view and update their name, phone number, email and profile photo.
Stores multiple delivery addresses and lets the buyer set a default for faster checkout.
Lets a signed in buyer change their password after confirming the current one.
Marketing page that explains the benefits of selling on KhmerCraft and starts the onboarding flow.
Collects store name, description, category, location and contact details during onboarding.
Presents the available seller plans with pricing and limits, and records the selected plan.
Processes the plan payment through the gateway and activates the seller account on success.
Summary screen with total sales, order count, low stock alerts and recent activity for the store.
Lists all products belonging to the signed in seller with stock, price and published status.
Form to create a product with title, price, category, description, stock and images.
Lets a seller update any field of an existing product they own.
Removes or archives a product, with a confirmation step and a guard for products in open orders.
Lets a seller adjust available quantity per product and flags items that are out of stock.
Lists incoming orders for the seller store, filterable by status and date.
Shows one order with buyer contact, delivery address, ordered items and payment status.
Lets a seller move an order through pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered or cancelled.
Lets a seller edit the public store profile shown to buyers, including name and description.
Manages store contact details, pickup location, delivery options and operating hours.
Uploads and crops the store logo and banner image with file type and size validation.
Reports revenue and units sold over a selected date range with a breakdown by product.
Lists past payouts to the seller with amount, period covered and transfer status.
Lets a seller read reviews left on their products and reply publicly to each one.
Manages the seller login email, password, notification preferences and bank payout details.
Platform wide summary of users, sellers, orders, revenue and items waiting for approval.
Lets an admin search, view, suspend or reactivate any buyer account on the platform.
Lets an admin view all seller stores, their plan, status and performance.
Review queue where an admin approves or rejects new seller applications with a reason.
Lets an admin moderate listings and unpublish products that break platform rules.
Creates, renames and deactivates the product categories used across the marketplace.
Read only view of every order across all stores for support and troubleshooting.
Analytics on sales, top sellers, top products and user growth, exportable for reporting.
Case workflow for buyer and seller complaints, including notes, resolution and refund decision.
Lets an admin review and release pending seller payouts for a settlement period.
Manages platform level configuration such as commission rate, delivery fees and plan pricing.
Shared top navigation that changes its links and account menu based on the signed in role.
Shared footer with about links, contact details, policies and social media.
Ensures every page works on mobile, tablet and desktop breakpoints.
Central service that sends transactional email for registration, password reset and order updates.
In product notification list for order status changes and seller announcements.
Shared upload and storage pipeline for product, store and profile images with size limits.
Single integration layer used by both buyer checkout and seller subscription payments.
Consistent request validation and error response format across every API endpoint.
Live Swagger UI documenting every endpoint so the API can be tested without the frontend.
Structured request and error logging to support debugging and production monitoring.
Rate limiting, password hashing, input sanitisation and protection of sensitive routes.
Khmer and English language switching across the buyer facing pages.
